correctness.rationale: The parallel update on lifted ordered positions gives p_i(t)=min_{0<=j<=t}(p_(i+j)(0)+t-2j), hence car-stop counts equal maxima of cyclic partial sums (1-g_i). Every complete tour contributes -h<=0, yielding finite exact workload w_i and cyclic Lindley recurrence w_i=max(0,1-g_i+w_(i+1)), with at least one zero. Conversely w plus a weak composition of h among zero coordinates reconstructs all gaps uniquely. Rooted-car double counting gives n/k; cyclic staircase from a zero proves D<=k(k-1)/2 with contiguous-block equality. Independently enumerated all site states in 20 complete (k,h) cases up to k=5,h=3 and recovered histogram/endpoints. General proof is combinatorial, not experimental.
